key_insight: PACT shows that token-level credit in RL can be uniquely defined by three principles and used to better align critic training with the updated policy.
engineering_relevance: The method improves post-training for LLMs and agentic reasoning by making actor-critic updates more stable and policy-consistent, with strong gains on math reasoning and SWE-bench.
method: Defines token-level credit with Completeness, Prefix Consistency, and Neutrality.
Interprets OPD teachers and RLOO signals as approximations to credit-based policy gradients.
Introduces Policy Aligned Critic Training (PACT) with Actor-then-Critic updates and importance-sampling correction.
evidence_signal: PACT reaches 72.87% average accuracy across four math reasoning benchmarks and 67.4% pass rate on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming PPO, GRPO, and SAO in the reported comparisons.
watch_item: The benefit depends on accurate importance-sampling correction and critic alignment, which may be sensitive to off-policy mismatch and implementation details.
paper_title: PACT: From Credit Assignment to Critic Alignment
